@state-graph/course.eras.broom.chapter.d: The sweep arm passes over a whole run of cells, so the number of ways in is no longer fixed.
@state-graph/course.eras.paper.chapter.d: Build the answer to a big problem out of the answers to small ones.
It sees further, two cells away; it sees more, the two words a table compares; and it can scan the other way round.
@state-graph/course.eras.reach.chapter.d: A telescopic arm reaches a cell however far away.

When the arrows loop round, scan again and again.
@state-graph/course.eras.stack.chapter.d: When one number can’t remember enough, remember one more thing.
@state-graph/game.description: 状态之图 State Graph：零基础动态规划解谜游戏。Dynamic programming puzzles for complete beginners.
@state-graph/game.lede: No programming or algorithms background needed. Starting from counting routes by hand, you learn to break a big problem into a table and fill it in cell by cell; in the end you wire up the circuit boards that count routes, compare words and pack a backpack, and see why they are so fast.
@state-graph/game.title: State Graph
